hints.title: Reverse one block at a time
hints.body: The overall list is a sequence of independent blocks. Solve the reversal for one full block, then reconnect it to the already processed prefix.

hints.title: Check before reversing
hints.body: A block should only be reversed if it contains exactly `k` nodes. Walk `k` steps first; if you fall off the chain, the remaining nodes stay as they are.

hints.title: Reconnect the boundaries
hints.body: Keep a pointer to the node before the current block. After reversing, that node must point to the block's new head, and the block's old head becomes the new predecessor for the next block.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
dummy = new node pointing to head
previousBlockEnd = dummy
loop:
    probe = previousBlockEnd
    repeat k times:
        probe = probe.next
        if probe is null: return dummy.next
    nextBlockStart = probe.next
    reverse the block from previousBlockEnd.next through probe
    oldBlockStart = previousBlockEnd.next
    previousBlockEnd.next = probe
    previousBlockEnd = oldBlockStart
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
